### Our Reluctance to Return to Normal
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-3-2021.html
Passage: Joshua 3:13
Points:
- Major life transitions and unknowns naturally stir reluctance and fear.
- God promised His presence and protection before the Israelites stepped into the flooded river.
- The miraculous holding back of the Jordan required the priests to place their feet in the water first.
- Experiencing God's provision often requires taking a step of faith before the path opens up.
- Hesitation can become a holy invitation to seek God’s direction rather than clinging to past routines.

### Concentrating on Consecration
Author: Wendy Pope
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-jan-1-2008-11563081.html
Passage: Joshua 3:5
Points:
- Believers often ask to see God's power but miss it because they fail to prepare their hearts.
- Consecration requires intentionally setting oneself apart from worldly habits to focus on God.
- Eliminating specific spiritual distractions opens the way to see God actively at work.
- God equips His people to walk in obedience whenever He calls them to purify their lives.

### Power Point - April 28, 2005
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-april-28-2005-1326537.html
Passage: Joshua 3:5
Points:
- Crucial life choices serve as defining moments that shape future spiritual direction.
- Standing at the threshold of the Promised Land required the Israelites to prepare through personal consecration.
- God desires to do wondrous and mighty works in the everyday lives of His people.
- Experiencing God's power requires taking deliberate pathways of trust and obedience.
